law: Evidence-derived aggregates are monitoring metrics and kill criteria ONLY - never officer-visible scores, never inputs to generation or selection. (Whole-cabinet evidence design, safety envelope 2.5, 2026-07-16; pinned by the Phase-1 laws wave.)

doctrine.never_a_score: Autonomy is itself a reward signal; no number may be displayed to make it a sharper one. Machine judges may only demote or withhold; promotion fuel stays human (Captain verdicts). Any consumer of an evidence-derived aggregate must be a monitoring or kill-criteria surface the officers cannot read.
doctrine.promotion_revocation: Purge/retention discipline (design 2.4): every purge and retention-shortening records its own evidence and fires an out-of-band anchor receipt; a fuel window overlapping a purge is reduced-confidence (withhold widened); a promotion whose supporting evidence window was later purged is REVOKED pending re-derivation from surviving evidence. No executable home exists until the Phase-4 fuel-integrity check; this fixture and the eval body carry the law so the ceremony that builds promotion machinery inherits it.
doctrine.scope_note: C1 is a token scan over tracked file contents; a consumer that constructs the series path dynamically evades the grammar - treat the evasion as the violation and label the consumer into the allowlist review when found. C2/C3 pin the single officer evidence read surface (cabinet_projection); aggregates computed elsewhere are covered insofar as they reach that surface or the scalar series.
